item.title: Skipping Your Taxes Isn’t A Good Protest. Redirecting Them Might Be.
item.description: If you want to stop giving out your tax money, there’s a better (and legal) way to funnel dollars into programs you care about.

item.title: Discover A Hidden Gem | LGBT-Friendly Bed & Breakfast
item.description: For more than two decades, life partners Patrick Dome and Karl Schmitt have offered queer travelers — and everyone else — a place in Cochise County.

item.title: Republican Lawmaker Wants ICE at Polling Places. That Would Be Illegal.
item.description: The proposal would station ICE at early voting sites, Election Day polls and ballot drop boxes, even though Arizona and federal law strictly limits law enforcement activity at voting locations.

item.title: In Surprise, Residents Push Back Against Proposed Detention Center
item.description: Worries over racial targeting, lost clientele, and roaming ICE agents loom as DHS plans to move into Phoenix suburb.

item.title: Arizona Drag Ban | HB 2589 | Performance & Free Expression
item.description: A leaked email reveals efforts to criminalize drag performances for minors as a way to provoke Democrats.

item.title: Trump Has Promoted More Deportations. One Couple’s Story Highlights the Human Toll.
item.description: As immigration took center stage, a Phoenix woman’s trip to the nation’s capital spotlighted her detained partner’s declining health and broader criticisms about LGBTQ+ safety in custody.

item.title: Understanding Unequal Voting Rights | Arizona SRP Election
item.description: Eligibility for the upcoming election is tied to historic farmland ownership, and excludes large portions of the Valley. Far-right political groups are seizing on that.

item.title: Bullhead City's Queer Sanctuary Takes Root
item.description: Mystic Energies Healing has grown from a local storefront into a national hub for LGBTQ connection and spiritual healing.

item.title: An Arizona Bill Could Restrict Uploading Satirical Content of Politicians. The Governor’s Office Is Eyeing It.
item.description: The bill, HB2133, would require anyone who uploads adult content to get permission from the people depicted.

item.title: A Magical Playground for the Wild, Weird, and Wonderful
item.description: Valley of the Moon has been delighting kids, punks, and queer folks for nearly 100 years—proof that whimsy isn’t just for storybooks.
